metadata.title: Go-Ethereum (Geth) Execution Client Formal Specification
metadata.description: Program Graph representation of the Geth Ethereum execution client for formal analysis and verification

trusted_entities.description: Manages proof-of-stake consensus, block proposals, and attestations. Drives the execution layer via Engine API. Examples: Prysm, Lighthouse, Teku, Lodestar, Nimbus.
The system under audit. Handles transaction processing, EVM execution, state management, and block validation. Implements the Ethereum execution layer specification.
trusted_entities.interface: Engine API, JSON-RPC API, P2P network

trusted_entities.description: External entity submitting transactions or querying state via JSON-RPC. Untrusted input source.
Other Ethereum nodes in the devp2p network. Source of transactions, blocks, and state data for synchronization.
Internal component responsible for assembling transactions into blocks when requested by consensus layer.
Core component executing smart contract bytecode. Processes opcodes, manages stack/memory, and modifies state.
Persistent storage layer managing account state, contract code, and storage via Merkle Patricia Trie.
Manages pending transactions awaiting inclusion in blocks. Validates and prioritizes transactions.

data_structures.name: ExecutionPayload
data_structures.description: Block data sent from CL to EL via Engine API. Contains parent hash, fee recipient, state root, receipts root, logs bloom, prev randao, block number, gas limit, gas used, timestamp, extra data, base fee, block hash, transactions, withdrawals (Shanghai+), blob gas used and excess blob gas (Cancun+), and execution requests (Prague+).

data_structures.name: ForkchoiceStateV1
data_structures.description: Fork choice information from CL specifying head block hash, safe block hash, and finalized block hash.

data_structures.name: PayloadAttributes
data_structures.description: Attributes for block building including timestamp, prev randao, suggested fee recipient, withdrawals (V2+), and parent beacon block root (V3+).

data_structures.name: PayloadStatusV1
data_structures.description: Response from EL indicating payload validity. Status can be VALID, INVALID, SYNCING, ACCEPTED, or INVALID_BLOCK_HASH. Includes latestValidHash and optional validationError.

data_structures.name: Transaction
data_structures.description: Ethereum transaction containing nonce, gas price/fee caps, gas limit, recipient, value, data, access list, and signature. Types include Legacy (0x00), EIP-2930 (0x01), EIP-1559 (0x02), EIP-4844 Blob (0x03), and EIP-7702 SetCode (0x04).

data_structures.name: Message
data_structures.description: Transaction decoded for EVM execution. Contains From, To, Nonce, Value, GasLimit, GasPrice, GasFeeCap, GasTipCap, Data, AccessList, BlobHashes, BlobGasFeeCap, and SetCodeAuthorizations.

data_structures.name: Block
data_structures.description: Complete Ethereum block containing header, transactions, uncles (legacy), and withdrawals. Header includes parent hash, uncle hash, coinbase, state root, tx root, receipt root, bloom, difficulty, number, gas limit, gas used, time, extra, mix digest, nonce, base fee, withdrawals hash, blob gas used, excess blob gas, parent beacon root, and requests hash.

data_structures.name: Receipt
data_structures.description: Transaction execution result containing type, post state or status, cumulative gas used, bloom filter, logs, tx hash, contract address, gas used, effective gas price, blob gas used, and blob gas price.

data_structures.name: stateObject
data_structures.description: In-memory representation of an Ethereum account including address, nonce, balance, code hash, code, storage trie root, and dirty storage slots.

data_structures.name: BlockContext + TxContext
data_structures.description: EVM execution context. BlockContext includes CanTransfer, Transfer, GetHash, Coinbase, GasLimit, BlockNumber, Time, Difficulty, BaseFee, BlobBaseFee, Random. TxContext includes Origin, GasPrice, BlobHashes, BlobFeeCap, AccessEvents.

data_structures.name: ScopeContext
data_structures.description: Per-call execution context containing Memory, Stack, and Contract reference for the current execution frame.

data_structures.name: ExecutionResult
data_structures.description: Result of EVM message execution including UsedGas, MaxUsedGas, Err (if any), and ReturnData.

data_structures.name: ProcessResult
data_structures.description: Result of processing an entire block including Receipts array, Requests (EIP-6110/7002/7251), Logs, and total GasUsed.

data_structures.name: JWT Authentication Token
data_structures.description: JSON Web Token used to authenticate Engine API requests between CL and EL. Required for all Engine API calls.

data_structures.name: Withdrawal
data_structures.description: Beacon chain withdrawal operation (EIP-4895) containing index, validator index, address, and amount in Gwei.

data_structures.name: BlobTxSidecar
data_structures.description: Blob data for EIP-4844 transactions containing blobs, commitments, and proofs. Stored separately from transaction.

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5656: MCOPY Opcode

nodes.description: 3 + 3 * ceil(length/32) + memory expansion

nodes.description: scope.Memory.Copy(dst, src, length) - handles overlapping

nodes.description: Check stored_timestamp == input_timestamp

nodes.label: Timestamp Mismatch - Revert

nodes.label: Return Beacon Root
